# 1. Get Started

```{r}
# Load packages
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
```


```{r}
# Load data
# st_transform matches the coordinate system (crs)
sb_protected_areas <- st_read(here("Discussions","data","week3_data", "cpad_super_units_sb.shp")) |>  
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")

sb_city_boundaries <- st_read(here("Discussions","data","week3_data", "sb_city_boundaries_2003.shp")) |> 
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")

sb_county_boundary <- st_read(here("Discussions","data","week3_data", "sb_county_boundary_2020.shp")) |> 
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")

aves <- st_read(here("Discussions","data","week3_data", "aves_observations_2020_2024.shp")) |> 
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")
```

# 2. Find bird observations within PAs in Santa Barbara County

Find how many bird observations are within protected areas in Santa Barbara County and show how your output differs with a spatial subset versus a spatial join.

```{r}
# Spatial subset
sb_birds <- st_join(aves, sb_protected_areas)

# Spatial join - use this
sb_birds2 <- sb_protected_areas[aves,]

# Check nrows
nrow(sb_birds)
nrow(sb_birds2)
```

35 rows result from the bracket filter. (aves no geometry) - 35 polygons have birds
500 rows result from the st_join() left. (combo yes geometry)
103 rows results from the st_join() inner. (combo yes geometry) - 103 birds are in polygons

```{r}
# Plot bracket filter map
tm_shape(sb_county_boundary) +
  tm_fill() +
  tm_shape(sb_protected_areas) +
    tm_borders(lwd = 1, col = "#fb8500") +
    tm_fill(col = "#fb8500", alpha = 0.2) +
  tm_shape(sb_birds2) +
    tm_dots(col = "#023047")
```


```{r}
# Plot st_join (left default) map
tm_shape(sb_county_boundary) +
  tm_fill() +
  tm_shape(sb_protected_areas) +
    tm_borders(lwd = 1, col = "#fb8500") +
    tm_fill(col = "#fb8500", alpha = 0.2) +
  tm_shape(sb_birds) +
    tm_dots(col = "#023047")
```

Make a 5 km buffer around the protected areas and subset buffered geometries to only those with bird observations

```{r}
# Check if units are in meters
st_crs(sb_protected_areas)$units 
```

```{r}
# Create 5000 m buffer around PAs
PA_buffer_5km <- st_buffer(sb_protected_areas, dist = 5000) 
```


```{r}
# Subset buffer areas to only those w/ bird observations
aves_buffer_subset <- PA_buffer_5km[aves, ]

# Check number of rows
nrow(aves_buffer_subset)
```

aves_buffer_subset has 327 rows.

```{r}
# Plot buffer area subset
tm_shape(sb_county_boundary) +
  tm_fill() +
  tm_shape(sb_protected_areas) +
    tm_borders(lwd = 1, col = "#fb8500") +
    tm_fill(col = "#fb8500", alpha = 0.2) +
  tm_shape(aves_buffer_subset) +
  tm_dots(col = "#023047")
```

# 3. Find PAs within 15km of Goleta

Find the protected areas within 15 km of a city in Santa Barbara County (Goleta).

Hint: Use dplyr::filter() to select a city from sb_city_boundaries

```{r}
# Subset SB county to Goleta
goleta <- sb_city_boundaries |> 
  dplyr::filter(NAME == "Goleta")

# Check units are meters
st_crs(goleta)$units
```

```{r}
# Create 15 km buffer around Goleta
goleta_buffer_15km <- st_buffer(goleta, dist = 15000)
```

Explore different outputs for #3 with st_intersects(), st_intersection(), and st_within()

```{r}
# st_within()
goleta_PAs_within <- st_within(sb_protected_areas, goleta_buffer_15km)

# st_intersect()
goleta_PAs_intersect <- st_intersects(sb_protected_areas, goleta_buffer_15km)

# st_intersection()
goleta_PAs_intersection <- st_intersection(sb_protected_areas, goleta_buffer_15km)

# Check lengths of above
sum(lengths(goleta_PAs_within) > 0)
sum(lengths(goleta_PAs_intersect) > 0)
nrow(goleta_PAs_intersection)
```

Practice a distance-based join with st_is_within_distance()

```{r}
# st_is_within_distance()
goleta_PAs_join <- st_join(sb_protected_areas, goleta, st_is_within_distance, dist = 15000)
```

# 4. Find distance between Goleta and Dangermond Preserve

Find the distance between your city of choice and a protected area of your choice, using the geometries’ edges and the centroid

```{r}
# Subset PA to Dangermond
dangermond <- sb_protected_areas |> 
    filter(UNIT_NAME == "Jack and Laura Dangermond Preserve")

danger_dist <- st_distance(goleta, dangermond)
```


```{r}
# Calculate the geometric center
dangermond_centroid <- st_centroid(dangermond)
goleta_centroid <- st_centroid(goleta)

# Compute the distance between geometries edges
danger_dist_centroid <- st_distance(goleta_centroid, dangermond_centroid)
```


```{r}
# Check if the distance matrices are equal
danger_dist == danger_dist_centroid
```
